## About this edition

This book is being converted from the Word module summaries used in Dr.
Durkee's Personality Psychology course. It is a work in progress: one module is
currently available while the conversion process is established, and the
remaining modules will follow.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Placeholders to resolve

These are unresolved and need a decision before the book is announced:

- **Licence.** No licence has been selected yet. "Open access" currently
  describes price, not reuse rights. A Creative Commons licence would make the
  terms explicit.
- **Full module list.** Thirteen modules exist in draft; only Module 10 has
  been converted so far.
- **Citation and version information.** How readers should cite the book, and
  whether editions should be versioned or dated.
:::
